story: Explore the fascinating world of the Pied Falconet (Microhierax melanoleucos). Classified under the Falconidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Subtropical evergreen broadleaf forest; forest edges; open woodland; and wooded foothills. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Pied Falconet is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Pied Falconet, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
